info.name: Smart CRM – Mekong Mobile API | BT3 SE (Documentation & Live Evidence)
info.description:
Documentation and live evidence for the 23 endpoints of the Smart CRM — Mekong Mobile L2 intake flow.

Import this collection together with `bt3-local.postman_environment.json`, select the **BT3 Local Demo** environment, set the `password` secret locally, then run folders 01 to 07 in order.

Every request contains seven English documentation sections and one saved response example captured on 12/11/2026 from the local Docker demo.

request.description:
## 1. Method and path
`GET /health`

## 2. Business purpose
Check whether the web service and MongoDB connection are ready.

## 3. Authentication and access
No authentication is required. The request explicitly overrides collection-level Bearer authentication with noauth.

## 4. Parameters and request body
None. No path parameters, query parameters, or request body are required.

## 5. Successful response body
**Expected HTTP 200** (the saved example records the observed run).

JSON object with `status` ("ok" if ready), `service`, `database` ("connected" if ready), and a changing `time` timestamp. Health does not use the `/api` data envelope.

**Captured evidence:** One real response from the local demo on 12 November 2026 is embedded in this request. See its saved example for the actual HTTP status, request, headers and JSON. The login JWT is redacted. This is not a Render capture or proof of a complete collection run.

## 6. Error codes
| HTTP status | Application code | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 503 | N/A | MongoDB connection is not ready; this is a health-status response, not the API error envelope. |

The health route uses a readiness response, not the business API error envelope.

## 7. Limitations and known constraints
Database connection state only; does not validate every business operation, record, or dependency.

## 1. Method and path
`POST /api/auth/login`

## 2. Business purpose
Authenticate the configured demonstration employee and return a JWT access token.

## 3. Authentication and access
No authentication is required. The request explicitly overrides collection-level Bearer authentication with noauth.

## 4. Parameters and request body
| Field | Location | Type | Required | Constraints / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| username | body | string | Yes | Non-empty demonstration employee username. |
| password | body | string | Yes | Non-empty demonstration employee password. |

**Executable example request body (test input, not a captured response):**

```json
{
  "username": "{{username}}",
  "password": "{{password}}"
}
```

## 5. Successful response body
**Expected HTTP 200** (the saved example records the observed run).

`data.token` is the JWT; `data.user` contains `username`, `fullName`, `role`, and `center_id`. Do not commit a live token in a saved example.

**Captured evidence:** One real response from the local demo on 12 November 2026 is embedded in this request. See its saved example for the actual HTTP status, request, headers and JSON. The login JWT is redacted. This is not a Render capture or proof of a complete collection run.

## 6. Error codes
| HTTP status | Application code | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | CHUA_DANG_NHAP | Invalid username or password. |
| 422 | DU_LIEU_KHONG_HOP_LE | Missing or invalid login fields. |
| 400 | DU_LIEU_KHONG_HOP_LE | Malformed JSON request body (when JSON body is submitted). |
| 413 | NOI_DUNG_QUA_LON | Request body exceeds configured size limit (when a body is submitted). |

## 7. Limitations and known constraints
Only the configured employee role is supported in this prototype. There is no account registration or token-refresh endpoint.

request.description:
## 1. Method and path
`POST /api/customers`

## 2. Business purpose
Register a customer with a unique normalized phone number.

## 3. Authentication and access
Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` with a valid NHAN_VIEN employee token and assigned service center. Customer/device records are currently shared across centers; this prototype does not enforce center ownership for these records.

## 4. Parameters and request body
| Field | Location | Type | Required | Constraints / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| full_name | body | string | Yes | Trimmed; 1–120 characters. |
| phone | body | string | Yes | Normalized to 10 digits starting with 0; unique even after soft deletion. |
| email | body | string or null | No | Valid email when provided; can be null/empty. |
| address | body | string | No | At most 255 characters. |
| segment | body | string | No | VIP, THUONG, or MOI; default THUONG. |
| created_at | body | ISO date/time | No | Defaults to server time; supported on creation, not on update. |

**Executable example request body (test input, not a captured response):**

```json
{
  "full_name": "BT3 API Test Customer",
  "phone": "{{testPhone}}",
  "email": "bt3-api@example.com",
  "address": "Local demonstration data",
  "segment": "MOI"
}
```

## 5. Successful response body
**Expected HTTP 201** (the saved example records the observed run).

`data` is the customer record, including `customer_id`, `full_name`, `phone`, `email`, `address`, `segment`, and record metadata.

**Captured evidence:** One real response from the local demo on 12 November 2026 is embedded in this request. See its saved example for the actual HTTP status, request, headers and JSON. The login JWT is redacted. This is not a Render capture or proof of a complete collection run.

## 6. Error codes
| HTTP status | Application code | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | CHUA_DANG_NHAP | Missing, invalid, or expired authentication token. |
| 409 | TRUNG_DU_LIEU | Phone number already exists, including soft-deleted records. |
| 422 | DU_LIEU_KHONG_HOP_LE | Invalid customer details. |
| 400 | DU_LIEU_KHONG_HOP_LE | Malformed JSON request body (when JSON body is submitted). |
| 413 | NOI_DUNG_QUA_LON | Request body exceeds configured size limit (when a body is submitted). |

## 7. Limitations and known constraints
Soft-deleted customer phone numbers still participate in the uniqueness rule. Customer records are shared across centers in this prototype.
